text.characters: Collect as many ideas as you can, group similar ones and vote for the best. No arguing or criticizing while ideas are being written.

f56.name: 1. For 5–10 minutes everyone writes ideas on stickies (S), o

text.characters:
1. For 5–10 minutes everyone writes ideas on stickies (S), one idea per sticky.
2. Take turns presenting the ideas and move similar ones together.
3. Select the stickies and use "Sort stickies" to order them by color or author.
4. Vote with stamps (E): everyone gets three votes.
5. Mark the best ideas and agree who does what.

text.characters: 8 minutes, 8 sketches, one minute for each. Draw with the marker (M) right in the frames, without worrying about looks. Then everyone shows theirs and we vote.
